blocks.text: Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin ikkinchi fe'l faqat **-ing** shaklida keladi: I **enjoy cooking**, She **avoided answering**. Asosiy ro'yxat qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 52-dars). Bu yerda -ing shakli ot vazifasini bajaradi va o'zbekchadagi «-ish» (harakat nomi) ga juda yaqin: «ovqat **pishirish** menga yoqadi», «javob **berishdan** qochdi». Bu darsda ro'yxatni B1–B2 darajasiga kengaytiramiz va nozik joylarni ko'ramiz: inkor (**not -ing**), o'tgan harakat uchun **having done**, fe'l bilan -ing orasidagi kishi (imagine **him doing**) va eng ko'p xato qilinadigan fe'l — **suggest**.

rows: He **gave up eating** meat last year.

items.text: Have you **finished packing**, or shall I wait for you downstairs?
items.translation: Narsalaringni **yig'ib bo'ldingmi** yoki pastda kutib turaymi?

items.text: The new manager **keeps changing** the rules, so nobody knows what to do.
items.translation: Yangi rahbar qoidalarni **o'zgartiraveradi**, shuning uchun hech kim nima qilishni bilmaydi.

items.text: I'd **avoid taking** the motorway on Friday evening — it's always jammed.
items.translation: Men bo'lsam, juma kuni kechqurun avtomagistraldan **yurmasdim** — u doim tiqilinch bo'ladi.

blocks.text: Nega aynan -ing? Bu fe'llarning ko'pi **mavjud yoki tasavvur qilingan harakatning o'zi** haqida: undan zavq olish, uni tugatish, undan qochish, uni tan olish. -ing — harakatning «nomi», xuddi ot kabi. Shuning uchun -ing o'rniga ko'pincha oddiy ot qo'ysa bo'ladi: I enjoyed **watching the film** / I enjoyed **the film**; He denied **stealing** / He denied **the theft**. **to** + fe'l bilan bunday qilib bo'lmaydi (→ 54-dars).
suggest — eng ko'p xato qilinadigan fe'l

O'zbekchada «taklif qildi» dan keyin bemalol «borish**ni**» deymiz, shuning uchun «She suggested to go» xatosi juda keng tarqalgan. Inglizchada **suggest** dan keyin **to** hech qachon kelmaydi va «suggest somebody to do» qolipi ham yo'q. Ikkita to'g'ri yo'l bor: **suggest + -ing** — taklif umumiy, ko'pincha gapiruvchining o'zini ham o'z ichiga oladi (birga qilaylik); **suggest (that) + ega + fe'l** — aniq kimdir nima qilishi kerakligi. Ikkinchi qolipda fe'l oddiy shaklda keladi (I suggest you **call** him) yoki **should** bilan (I suggest you **should call** him); Britaniyada odatdagi zamon shakli ham ishlatiladi (She suggested that he **called** back later).

rows: She suggested to go by train.
I suggest you to call him.
They suggested us a new plan.

items.text: Oliver **suggested having** the meeting online to save time.
items.translation: Oliver vaqtni tejash uchun yig'ilishni onlayn **o'tkazishni taklif qildi**.

items.text: The doctor **suggested** that I **should cut** down on salt.
What do you **suggest** we **do** with all this leftover food?
items.translation: Shuncha ortib qolgan ovqatni nima **qilishimizni taklif qilasiz**?

blocks.text: **admit** (tan olmoq) va **deny** (inkor qilmoq, rad etmoq) ko'pincha **o'tgan** harakat haqida gapiradi: He **denied taking** the money — Pulni **olganini** inkor qildi. E'tibor bering: inglizchada oddiy -ing ham o'tgan ma'noni beradi, chunki vaqtni birinchi fe'l (denied) ko'rsatib turibdi. O'zbekchada esa «-gan» shakli kerak: ol**gan**ini, qil**gan**ini. Harakat avvalroq bo'lganini alohida ta'kidlash uchun **having + V3** ishlatiladi: He **denied having taken** the money. Ma'no o'sha, faqat rasmiyroq va aniqroq. Bu ikki fe'ldan keyin to'liq gap ham kelishi mumkin: He **admitted that** he had lied.

Ikkinchi fe'lni inkor qilish uchun **not** to'g'ridan-to'g'ri -ing dan oldin qo'yiladi: I **considered not going**. Birinchi fe'l inkor qilinsa, ma'no butunlay boshqacha bo'ladi: I **didn't consider going** — «borishni xayolimga ham keltirmadim»; I **considered not going** — «bormaslik haqida o'yladim». O'zbekchada bu farq «-ish» va «-maslik» bilan beriladi: bor**ish**ni o'ylamadim / bor**maslik**ni o'yladim. `-maslik` — «not -ing» ning eng aniq tarjimasi.

items.text: I really **enjoy not having** a car — I walk or cycle everywhere.
items.translation: **Mashinam yo'qligi** menga juda **yoqadi** — hamma joyga piyoda yoki velosipedda boraman.

items.text: We **considered not inviting** him, but in the end we sent him a card.
items.translation: Uni **taklif qilmaslikni o'ylab ko'rdik**, lekin oxiri unga taklifnoma yubordik.

items.text: We **didn't consider inviting** him at all — he lives too far away.
items.translation: Uni **taklif qilishni** umuman **o'ylamadik** — u juda uzoqda yashaydi.

blocks.text: **imagine**, **mind**, **stop**, **keep**, **risk** kabi fe'llardan keyin -ing dan oldin harakatni bajaradigan kishi qo'yilishi mumkin: I can't **imagine him cooking** — «Uning ovqat pishirishini tasavvur qila olmayman». Kishi ob'ekt olmoshi (me, him, her, us, them) yoki ot bilan beriladi. Rasmiy uslubda egalik olmoshi ham uchraydi (Do you mind **my asking**?), lekin kundalik nutqda **me asking** odatiyroq. O'zbekchada kishi egalik qo'shimchasi bilan ifodalanadi: so'ra**shim**ga, pishir**ishi**ni. Bu qolip hamma fe'l bilan ishlamaydi: «suggest him going» deyilmaydi — faqat suggest (that) he **goes**.

items.text: I can't **imagine** my boss **saying** sorry to anyone.
items.translation: Boshlig'imning birovdan **kechirim so'rashini tasavvur qila olmayman**.

items.text: Do you **mind** us **leaving** our bags here for an hour?
items.translation: Sumkalarimizni bir soatga shu yerda **qoldirsak qarshi emasmisiz**?

items.text: You can't **stop** people **talking**, so just ignore the gossip.
items.translation: Odamlarning **gapirishini to'xtata olmaysiz**, shuning uchun mish-mishlarga e'tibor bermang.

blocks.text: Ko'p frazali fe'llardan keyin ham **-ing** keladi: **give up** (tashlamoq), **put off** (paysalga solmoq), **carry on** / **go on** (davom etmoq), **keep on** (qayta-qayta qilaverish), **end up** (oxir-oqibat ... bo'lib qolmoq): We **ended up staying** at home — Oxiri uyda qolib ketdik. Sababi oddiy: fe'ldan keyin up, off, on kabi so'z turgan bo'lsa, keyingi fe'l deyarli doim -ing bo'ladi (predloglardan keyin -ing → 60-dars). **keep** va **keep on** deyarli bir xil, faqat keep on takror va norozilikni kuchaytiradi: He **keeps on interrupting** me! O'zbekchada bu ma'noni «-averadi» yaxshi beradi: gapimni bo'l**averadi**. **go on** to bilan ham keladi va ma'nosi o'zgaradi (→ 56-dars).

-ing yoki that ...? **admit**, **deny**, **suggest**, **imagine**, **mention**, **recommend** dan keyin to'liq ergash gap ham kelishi mumkin: He **admitted that** he had lied; I **suggest that** we leave early. Ma'no bir xil, faqat that-gapda ega alohida ko'rsatiladi. **enjoy**, **avoid**, **finish**, **keep**, **give up** dan keyin esa that-gap kelmaydi.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I enjoy to travel.» → I **enjoy travelling**.; «She suggested me to apply.» → She **suggested** (that) I **apply**.; «He denied to take the money.» → He **denied taking** the money.; «I avoid to eat sugar.» → I **avoid eating** sugar.; «I'm thinking to change my job.» → I'm **considering changing** / I'm **thinking of changing** my job.; «Do you mind to open the door?» → Do you **mind opening** the door?; «I didn't consider to go» va «I considered not going» ni aralashtirish — not ikkinchi fe'lga tegishli bo'lsa, u -ing dan oldin turadi.

Eslab qolish: o'zbekchada fe'l «-ish**dan**» (gapir**ishdan** to'xtadi, javob ber**ishdan** qochdi) yoki «-gan**ini**» (ol**gan**ini tan oldi, ko'r**gan**ini inkor qildi) bilan kelsa, inglizchada deyarli doim **-ing**. «-ish**ga** qaror qildim / va'da berdim / ulgurdim» esa ko'pincha **to** (→ 54-dars). Bu 100% qoida emas (mind -ing — «-ishga qarshi emasman»), lekin ko'p fe'lni to'g'ri tanlashga yordam beradi.

rows: Uning chet elda yashashini tasavvur qila olmayman.
She **suggested leaving** early. / She suggested we **leave** early.

examples.title: **enjoy**, **don't mind**, **fancy** + -ing
examples.description: Harakatga munosabat: undan zavq olish (enjoy), unga qarshi bo'lmaslik (don't mind), uni xohlash (fancy — Britaniyada so'zlashuv uslubi).

sentences.text: Sarah really **enjoys working** with children, so she became a primary school teacher.
sentences.translation: Sara bolalar bilan **ishlashni** juda **yaxshi ko'radi**, shuning uchun boshlang'ich sinf o'qituvchisi bo'ldi.

sentences.text: I **don't mind driving** at night, but I hate driving in heavy rain.
sentences.translation: Kechasi mashina **haydash** menga **malol kelmaydi**, lekin kuchli yomg'irda haydashni yomon ko'raman.

sentences.text: Do you **fancy going** to the cinema after work? — Not tonight, I'm exhausted.
sentences.translation: Ishdan keyin kinoga **borging kelmayaptimi**? — Bugun emas, juda charchadim.

sentences.text: Would you **mind turning** the music down a little? The baby is asleep.
sentences.translation: Musiqani biroz **pasaytirib qo'ymaysizmi**? Chaqaloq uxlab yotibdi.

sentences.text: Bekzod doesn't **enjoy being** the centre of attention at parties.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ziyofatlarda diqqat markazida **bo'lishni yoqtirmaydi**.

sentences.text: Most people **don't mind paying** more for food that is grown locally.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik mahalliy yetishtirilgan oziq-ovqat uchun ko'proq **pul to'lashga qarshi emas**.

sentences.text: After a long week at the office, I don't really **fancy cooking**, so let's order a pizza.
sentences.translation: Ofisdagi uzoq haftadan keyin **ovqat pishirgim kelmayapti**, pitsa buyurtma qilaylik.

sentences.text: Did you **enjoy studying** in Edinburgh, or was the weather too much for you?
sentences.translation: Edinburgda **o'qish sizga yoqdimi** yoki ob-havo og'irlik qildimi?

sentences.text: My grandmother **enjoys telling** stories about her childhood in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Buvim Buxorodagi bolaligi haqida **hikoya qilib berishni yaxshi ko'radi**.

sentences.text: If you **don't mind waiting**, the manager will be free in ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Agar **kutishga qarshi bo'lmasangiz**, menejer o'n daqiqadan keyin bo'shaydi.

examples.title: Ending things: **finish**, **stop**, **give up**, **quit**
examples.description: Harakatni tugatish yoki tashlash: finish (oxiriga yetkazmoq), stop (to'xtatmoq), give up / quit (butunlay tashlamoq).

sentences.text: Have you **finished writing** the report, or do you need another day?
sentences.translation: Hisobotni **yozib bo'ldingizmi** yoki yana bir kun kerakmi?

sentences.text: My father **gave up smoking** ten years ago, and he feels much healthier now.
sentences.translation: Otam o'n yil oldin **chekishni tashlagan**, hozir o'zini ancha sog'lom his qiladi.

sentences.text: **Stop interrupting** me — let me finish my sentence first!
sentences.translation: Gapimni **bo'lishni bas qil** — avval fikrimni oxiriga yetkazib olay!

sentences.text: Emma **quit working** at the bank because the hours were far too long.
sentences.translation: Ish soatlari haddan tashqari uzun bo'lgani uchun Emma bankda **ishlashni tashladi**.

sentences.text: The phone **stopped ringing** just as I reached it.
sentences.translation: Yetib borishim bilan telefon **jiringlashdan to'xtadi**.

sentences.text: Once you **finish checking** the figures, send them to James in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Raqamlarni **tekshirib bo'lgach**, ularni Manchesterdagi Jeymsga yuboring.

sentences.text: Don't **give up trying** — lots of people fail their driving test the first time.
sentences.translation: Urinishdan **voz kechmang** — ko'pchilik haydovchilik imtihonidan birinchi marta o'ta olmaydi.

sentences.text: When did it **stop snowing** in Tashkent? — Around midnight, I think.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda qor qachon **yog'ishdan to'xtadi**? — Menimcha, yarim tunga yaqin.

sentences.text: Jasur has **finished paying** for his car at last, so he can start saving.
sentences.translation: Jasur nihoyat mashinasining pulini **to'lab bo'ldi**, endi pul yig'ishni boshlashi mumkin.

sentences.text: Many students **stop reading** for pleasure once they start university, which is a pity.
sentences.translation: Ko'p talabalar universitetga kirgach, zavq uchun **kitob o'qishni to'xtatadi** — bu achinarli.

examples.title: Not now: **avoid**, **put off**, **postpone**, **delay**
examples.description: Harakatdan qochish (avoid) va uni keyinga surish (put off, postpone, delay). O'zbekchada «-ishdan qochmoq», «-ishni paysalga solmoq».

sentences.text: I always **avoid driving** through the city centre during the rush hour.
sentences.translation: Tig'iz soatlarda shahar markazidan mashinada **o'tishdan** doim **qochaman**.

sentences.text: We've **put off buying** a new car until prices come down.
sentences.translation: Narxlar tushmaguncha yangi mashina **sotib olishni keyinga qoldirdik**.

sentences.text: The committee **postponed making** a decision until the next meeting.
sentences.translation: Qo'mita qaror **qabul qilishni** keyingi yig'ilishgacha **kechiktirdi**.

sentences.text: Nilufar **avoided looking** at me during the whole meeting — was she angry?
sentences.translation: Nilufar butun yig'ilish davomida mendan **ko'zini olib qochdi** — jahli chiqqanmidi?

sentences.text: Doctors say you should **avoid eating** heavy meals late in the evening.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlarning aytishicha, kechqurun kech og'ir ovqat **yeyishdan saqlanish** kerak.

sentences.text: Stop **putting off going** to the dentist — the pain won't disappear by itself.
sentences.translation: Tish shifokoriga **borishni paysalga solishni** bas qiling — og'riq o'z-o'zidan ketmaydi.

sentences.text: Can we **delay starting** the meeting by fifteen minutes? Oliver is stuck in traffic.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishni **boshlashni** o'n besh daqiqaga **kechiktira olamizmi**? Oliver tirbandlikda qolib ketdi.

sentences.text: If you want to **avoid paying** extra, book your tickets at least a month in advance.
sentences.translation: Ortiqcha **pul to'lamaslik** uchun chiptalarni kamida bir oy oldin bron qiling.

sentences.text: Madina has been **putting off telling** her parents that she wants to study abroad.
sentences.translation: Madina chet elda o'qimoqchi ekanini ota-onasiga **aytishni paysalga solib yuribdi**.

sentences.text: They've decided to **postpone moving** to London until their daughter finishes school.
sentences.translation: Ular qizlari maktabni bitirguncha Londonga **ko'chishni kechiktirishga** qaror qilishdi.

examples.title: Thinking ahead: **consider**, **imagine**, **suggest**
examples.description: Hali bo'lmagan harakat haqida o'ylash, uni tasavvur qilish, taklif yoki tavsiya qilish. suggest — -ing bilan yoki (that) + ega + fe'l bilan.

sentences.text: Have you ever **considered working** abroad for a year or two?
sentences.translation: Bir-ikki yil chet elda **ishlashni** hech **o'ylab ko'rganmisiz**?

sentences.text: We're **considering moving** to Samarkand, where house prices are lower.
sentences.translation: Uy narxlari arzonroq bo'lgan Samarqandga **ko'chishni o'ylab ko'ryapmiz**.

sentences.text: Kate **suggested taking** the train instead of flying, which saved us a lot of money.
sentences.translation: Keyt samolyot o'rniga **poyezdda borishni taklif qildi**, bu bizga ancha pul tejadi.

sentences.text: Can you **imagine living** without the internet for a whole month?
sentences.translation: Bir oy davomida internetsiz **yashashni tasavvur qila olasizmi**?

sentences.text: The doctor **recommended doing** some light exercise every morning.
sentences.translation: Shifokor har kuni ertalab yengil **mashq qilishni tavsiya qildi**.

sentences.text: I **suggest** that you **talk** to your manager before you resign.
sentences.translation: Ishdan ketishdan oldin rahbaringiz bilan **gaplashib ko'rishingizni maslahat beraman**.

sentences.text: Aziz never **imagined becoming** a famous chef when he was a shy teenager in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Farg'onada uyatchan o'smir bo'lganida, Aziz mashhur oshpaz **bo'lishni xayoliga ham keltirmagan**.

sentences.text: **Would** you **consider changing** the date of the conference to October?
sentences.translation: Konferensiya sanasini oktyabrga **o'zgartirishni ko'rib chiqa olasizmi**?

sentences.text: Someone **suggested** we **meet** halfway, in a café near the station.
sentences.translation: Kimdir yarim yo'lda — vokzal yaqinidagi kafeda **uchrashishni taklif qildi**.

sentences.text: The council is **considering building** a new bridge across the river.
sentences.translation: Shahar kengashi daryo ustidan yangi ko'prik **qurishni ko'rib chiqyapti**.

examples.title: Owning up: **admit**, **deny**, **having done**
examples.description: Tan olish va inkor qilish — odatda o'tgan harakat haqida. Oddiy -ing ham, having + V3 ham bir xil ma'no beradi; o'zbekchada «-ganini».

sentences.text: The driver **admitted going** through a red light, but said he hadn't seen it.
sentences.translation: Haydovchi qizil chiroqda **o'tganini tan oldi**, lekin uni ko'rmaganini aytdi.

sentences.text: Our local MP **denied taking** money from a construction company.
sentences.translation: Mahalliy deputatimiz qurilish kompaniyasidan **pul olganini rad etdi**.

sentences.text: Jasur finally **admitted breaking** his sister's laptop.
sentences.translation: Jasur nihoyat singlisining noutbukini **sindirganini tan oldi**.

sentences.text: She **denies having said** anything rude about her colleagues.
sentences.translation: U hamkasblari haqida qo'pol gap **aytganini inkor qiladi**.

sentences.text: Do you **admit making** a mistake, or are you going to blame someone else?
sentences.translation: Xato **qilganingizni tan olasizmi** yoki boshqa birovni ayblamoqchimisiz?

sentences.text: Two students **denied copying** each other's essays, although the texts were almost identical.
sentences.translation: Matnlar deyarli bir xil bo'lsa ham, ikki talaba bir-birining inshosidan **ko'chirganini rad etdi**.

sentences.text: I **admit having been** a bit lazy last term, but I'll work harder now.
sentences.translation: O'tgan semestrda biroz **dangasalik qilganimni tan olaman**, lekin endi ko'proq harakat qilaman.

sentences.text: Nobody **admitted leaving** the office door unlocked last night.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun ofis eshigini **qulflamay ketganini** hech kim **bo'yniga olmadi**.

sentences.text: The company **denies having known** about the problem before the news broke.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya yangilik tarqalmasidan oldin muammo haqida **bilganini inkor qilmoqda**.

sentences.text: Why won't you **admit being** wrong? Everyone can see it.
sentences.translation: Nega **noto'g'ri ekaningizni tan olmaysiz**? Buni hamma ko'rib turibdi.

examples.title: **not** + -ing and verb + person + -ing
examples.description: Ikkinchi fe'lning inkori — not -ing («-maslik»). Fe'l bilan -ing orasida kishi: imagine **him doing**, mind **me asking**.

sentences.text: I'm **considering not going** to the party — I've got an exam the next morning.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatga **bormaslikni o'ylayapman** — ertasi kuni ertalab imtihonim bor.

sentences.text: Imagine **not having** to set an alarm every morning — that's what retirement is like!
sentences.translation: Har tong budilnik **qo'yishga majbur bo'lmaslikni** tasavvur qiling — nafaqa degani shu!

sentences.text: She **admitted not reading** the instructions carefully before she started.
sentences.translation: U boshlashdan oldin ko'rsatmalarni diqqat bilan **o'qimaganini tan oldi**.

sentences.text: Kate **suggested not telling** anyone about the surprise party until Friday.
sentences.translation: Keyt juma kunigacha hech kimga kutilmagan ziyofat haqida **aytmaslikni taklif qildi**.

sentences.text: I can't **imagine** Bekzod **cooking** dinner for ten people!
sentences.translation: Bekzodning o'n kishiga kechki ovqat **pishirishini tasavvur ham qila olmayman**!

sentences.text: Do you **mind** me **asking** how much you paid for your flat?
sentences.translation: Kvartirangizga qancha to'laganingizni **so'rasam xafa bo'lmaysizmi**?

sentences.text: Sorry for **keeping** you **waiting** — the traffic on the ring road was terrible.
sentences.translation: Sizni **kuttirib qo'yganim** uchun uzr — halqa yo'lida tirbandlik dahshatli edi.

sentences.text: Nothing will **stop** him **trying** again next year — he's very determined.
sentences.translation: Hech narsa uni kelasi yili yana **urinib ko'rishdan to'xtata olmaydi** — u juda qat'iyatli.

sentences.text: My parents **don't mind** me **staying** at a friend's house at the weekend.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari do'stimnikida **qolishimga** ota-onam **qarshi emas**.

sentences.text: Can you **imagine** your grandparents **using** a smartphone to order a taxi?
sentences.translation: Bobo-buvingiz taksi chaqirish uchun **smartfondan foydalanishini tasavvur qila olasizmi**?

examples.title: **keep**, **carry on**, **risk**, **miss**, **involve**
examples.description: Davom etish va takrorlash (keep, carry on), xavf (risk), mashq (practise), sog'inch (miss) va «o'z ichiga olmoq» (involve) — hammasi -ing bilan.

sentences.text: The printer **keeps jamming**, so I'll call the IT department.
sentences.translation: Printerga qog'oz **tiqilib qolaveryapti**, IT bo'limiga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.

sentences.text: Even after the fire alarm went off, some people **carried on working**.
sentences.translation: Yong'in signali chalingandan keyin ham ba'zilar **ishlashda davom etdi**.

sentences.text: If you don't take your car to the garage, you **risk breaking down** on the motorway.
sentences.translation: Mashinangizni ustaxonaga olib bormasangiz, avtomagistralda **buzilib qolish xavfi bor**.

sentences.text: Oliver **practises speaking** Uzbek with his colleagues every lunch break.
sentences.translation: Oliver har tushlik tanaffusida hamkasblari bilan o'zbekcha **gapirishni mashq qiladi**.

sentences.text: Since moving to Oxford, Nilufar really **misses eating** her mother's samsa.
sentences.translation: Oksfordga ko'chganidan beri Nilufar onasi pishirgan somsani juda **sog'inib yuribdi**.

sentences.text: **Keep going** straight until you see the mosque, then turn left.
sentences.translation: Masjidni ko'rmaguningizcha to'g'riga **yuravering**, keyin chapga buriling.

sentences.text: Don't **keep on asking** me the same question — I've already told you!
sentences.translation: Menga bir xil savolni **qayta-qayta beraverma** — allaqachon aytdim-ku!

sentences.text: Climbers who ignore the weather forecast **risk getting** caught in a storm.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo ma'lumotiga quloq solmaydigan alpinistlar bo'ronga **tushib qolish xavfi ostida qoladi**.

sentences.text: Do you **miss living** near the sea, or are you happy in Manchester?
sentences.translation: Dengiz yaqinida **yashashni sog'inasizmi** yoki Manchesterda baxtlimisiz?

sentences.text: The job **involves travelling** abroad twice a month, which is why I applied.
sentences.translation: Bu ishda oyiga ikki marta chet elga **safar qilish bor** — shuning uchun ariza topshirdim.

examples.title: Dialogue: thinking about a new career
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ikki do'st ish o'zgartirish haqida gaplashadi — consider, keep, imagine, enjoy, risk, give up, miss, admit, suggest, mind.

sentences.text: — Emma, have you ever **considered leaving** your job at the bank?
sentences.translation: — Emma, bankdagi ishingdan **ketishni** hech **o'ylab ko'rganmisan**?

sentences.text: — Honestly, I **keep thinking** about it, but I **can't imagine starting** again.
sentences.translation: — Rostini aytsam, bu haqda **o'ylayveraman**, lekin hammasini qaytadan **boshlashni tasavvur qila olmayman**.

sentences.text: — Why not? You **don't enjoy sitting** in meetings all day, do you?
sentences.translation: — Nega? Kun bo'yi majlislarda **o'tirish senga yoqmaydi**-ku, to'g'rimi?

sentences.text: — True, but I'd **risk losing** a good salary and a decent pension.
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri, lekin yaxshi maosh va durustgina pensiyadan **ayrilib qolish xavfi bor**.

sentences.text: — My cousin **gave up working** in finance and opened a café in Khiva.
sentences.translation: — Amakivachcham moliyada **ishlashni tashlab**, Xivada kafe ochdi.

sentences.text: — Really? And does he **miss having** a regular income?
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? Doimiy **daromadi bo'lganini sog'inmaydimi**?

sentences.text: — He **admits worrying** about money sometimes, but he's much happier now.
sentences.translation: — Ba'zan pul haqida **xavotirlanishini tan oladi**, lekin hozir ancha baxtli.

sentences.text: — Then maybe I should **stop dreaming** and **start planning** properly.
sentences.translation: — Unda balki **orzu qilishni bas qilib**, jiddiy **reja tuzishni boshlashim** kerakdir.

sentences.text: — I'd **suggest talking** to a career adviser before you do anything.
sentences.translation: — Biror ish qilishdan oldin karyera maslahatchisi bilan **gaplashib ko'rishni maslahat beraman**.

sentences.text: — Good idea! Would you **mind sending** me your adviser's phone number?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r fikr! Maslahatchingning telefon raqamini menga **yuborib qo'ymaysanmi**?
